rules.text: Moves (sheets, page push/pop, tab and nav pills, rows opening) ride the Smooth spring 240 / 30 / 1 (PS.MT.SPRING): never sped up for a short move, no bounce. A travel longer than 378 px stretches the same spring (s = travel/378 ≤ 2.5: stiffness ÷ s², damping ÷ s).
rules.how: All geometry uses MT.SPRING / SPRING_PCT; stretchSpring(travel) implements the >378 px stretch.

rules.text: Content that is replaced (text after a tap, a tab's list, toasts, tooltips) crossfades: PS.fade / PS.Swap / PS.Crossfade — LEAVE 0.15 s rising out, ENTER 0.30 s + 0.07 s delay rising 8–10 px, 3 px blur between.
rules.how: fade(), Swap, Crossfade, PageTransition, Toaster, Tooltip all use ENTER / LEAVE + 3 px blur.

rules.text: Press: PS.press() — 60 ms, scale 0.985 (buttons, cards) / 0.92 (icon buttons), no bounce.

rules.text: Numbers that follow the slider never animate (amounts, savings, totals just update). Key Swap on the state, never on a number that follows a slider.
rules.how: No number animates; Swap documents the rule; production slider numbers update in place.

rules.text: The slider follows the finger at once; when something else moves it (a coupon raises or removes the limit, 'Keep coupon' sets the amount) the knob, fill and amount glide there on the Smooth spring — the amount counts in slider steps.
rules.how: Withdraw slider glide on the Smooth spring when moved by something other than the finger (M-106, LAYOUT_GLIDE).

rules.text: A page or sheet that is leaving takes no taps (pointer-events none while exiting), so nothing blocks the next tap.
rules.how: PageTransition (useIsPresent), Sheet (scrim + panel pointer-events none), Popover (rootClosing + inert), Toaster (only the top toast takes pointer events).

rules.text: Lists are popovers: like an iPhone menu they open centred on where the finger tapped (8 px from the page sides), grow out of that point on a light-bounce spring (PS.MT.MENU — the one thing that bounces), rows following one after another; a picked row lights up, then it folds away.
rules.how: Popover + SelectPopover (MENU springs, tap origin, row stagger, pick then fold).

rules.text: Toasts sit at the top, 8 px under the header bar, like iPhone notifications. Every call shows a new one at once (never queued or merged); the new one covers the old, which moves down a little, shrinks and fades (a stack of 3, not a list); a swipe left closes one.
rules.how: Toaster at the top, 8 px under the header (0rem fallbacks); stack of 3; swipe left. Toast.show position is ignored (OPEN-DECISIONS 6).

rules.text: Page changes crossfade, like home's tabs — never a sideways slide (PS.Pages).
rules.how: Crossfade only (dir 0); no sideways slide.

rules.text: Loading is the whole screen and nothing else (PS.Cover: no header, bars); the loader (72 px coin + dots) is in the very middle; Order submit's coin and text a little above the middle; empty states and the fallback put their picture at that height. What was waited for then rises in piece by piece (PS.Rise).
rules.how: Cover + Rise ready; Loading wrapper exits on LEAVE; repayment list rises after load.

rules.text: Secondary content (rows, details, loaded content) enters on a clock: 0.34 s on the ENTER curve, rising its MT.Y distance into focus from a 3 px blur, items one after another.
rules.how: rise() / reveal() values 1:1.

rules.text: Order submit plays only after Confirm on apply-a-loan (after the code); it is over — and home shows — only when the last line has come in and held 1500 ms AND the tick has finished. The coin finishes its loading turn before the success part (no deadline).

rules.text: Animations replace stills: wherever Figma shows a still that has an animation in animations/, the app plays it (PS.Anim).
rules.how: Coins / dots are GSAP ports; stills without a production animation file stay still (M-085 partial).

rules.text: Carousels of animations: only the card on screen plays, and it plays again from the start each time it is swiped to (PS.Anim{active}).
rules.how: FraudWarningSheet: only the step on screen is active; production art is static, nothing to replay (M-064).

rules.text: Bars have no colour while they cover nothing: the header veil fades in as content scrolls under it (first 24 px), the bottom/tab bar veil fades out over the last stretch of scroll (as tall as the bar); a page that doesn't scroll shows none.
rules.how: useScrollVeil + header / tab-bar CSS vars.

rules.text: Every sheet whose content scrolls has a veil at its top (the sheet's colour 80 % → 0) so what scrolls up fades out; the drag handle is always the top layer.
rules.how: Grab handle is the top layer (z 4) when shown; scrolling sheets' top veil (sheet colour 80% → 0) is per sheet CSS — add when sheets are restyled.

rules.text: Card morph core rules: one progress k + one spring (no per-property springs); geometry on k clamped, opacity/blur on smoothstep windows (leaving gone by ≈0.4, arriving from ≈0.2); shared elements stay one element (FLIP); nothing is cut by a moving edge (ride it); crossing paths front-loaded 1-(1-k)²; secondary content on a 0.34 s clock started by k; colour rides the progress (two flat layers); per frame only transform/opacity/filter (+ card size), write only changed values, will-change only during the morph; reduced motion jumps to the end.
rules.how: withdrawMorph.ts: one progress k on MORPH_SPRING, geometry on clamped k, opacity/blur on windows, shared glyphs FLIP (M-107).

rules.text: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: PS.Shell sets MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'; PS.reduce gates WAAPI rises, Lottie (resting frame), glides and ripples; CSS loops have @media reduce overrides where noted.
rules.how: MotionRoot reducedMotion="user"; rise() and the popover check prefers-reduced-motion; CSS loops (busy) carry @media overrides.

rules.text: Use Motion (formerly Framer Motion) with LazyMotion + m (strict, domMax); drive continuous values with motion values instead of React state; animate only transform / opacity where possible.
rules.how: motion 14.4.0, LazyMotion strict + m.*, domMax; motion values for scroll veils (CSS vars, no React state).

rules.text: Tooltips place themselves: a corner covers what was tapped and reaches 12 px past it on both sides; never off screen (16 px margins); grows from the anchor on ENTER, goes on LEAVE.
rules.how: Grow from anchor done (CreditValidityTooltip); its placement stays the Figma per-surface one; placeTooltip() has the demo rule for new tooltips.
